title: Thursday Quick Tip
subtitle: Tournament weekends
hook: Three games in one day. How do you manage it?
intro: By the third game, legs are gone.
statement: A long day needs a plan for energy, not just lineups.
q1: Do you plan rest and food between every game —
q2: or let families handle the breaks?
q3: How do kids look in game three?
t1: There is no single right way. But teams finish strong
t2: when the breaks are planned too.
cta: Coaches — how do you handle tournaments?
ctaLines: Snacks and shade. Rotate more. Short talks.
Plan the breaks or let families handle it?
ctaPrompt: Share your tournament habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Three games in one day. How do you manage it?
The first game goes fine. By the third game, legs are gone.
A long day needs a plan for energy, not just lineups.
Plan the breaks or let families handle them. There is no perfect answer.
How do you handle tournaments? Share your habit in the comments.
